So just flight cost. Also maybe need to consider currency conversion? They didn't specify currency. We can assume USD. So we need to get flight cost. Then provide estimate.

We also might need to authenticate? For get_flight_cost, no auth needed. So we can call get_flight_cost with travel_from=first airport code, travel_to=last airport code, travel_date='2024-10-31', travel_class='business'.

But we need to get the list of airports first. So call list_all_airports. That returns list of airports. Then pick first and last. Then call get_flight_cost. Then output.

We don't need to book yet. Just estimate. So let's do that.
